answer: The karst of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the quill of a task receipt, and the inlet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit.
